title: Token emission sampling and cache-effect reconciliation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Current per-token instrumentation captures high-fidelity timing and KV cache signals but at significant telemetry volume and added CPU overhead on hot inference paths. This ticket implements an adaptive sampling layer for token-level traces plus a reconciliation pass to attribute cost deltas caused by KV cache hits/misses. Goals: 1) Reduce trace and metric volume from token-level instrumentation by ~6x for tail workloads while preserving accuracy within 3% for aggregate cost attribution; 2) Emit a compact reconciliation record per request that quantifies how much KV cache changed per-token latency/cost; 3) Provide dashboards and an automated QA job to validate attribution accuracy across common workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive sampler implemented as a pluggable tracing hook with config: sample_rate, burst_size, stratify_by (model, sequence_len, route)

Reconciliation record emitted to telemetry pipeline: fields [request_id, sampled_token_count, inferred_total_tokens, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_miss_latency_us, estimated_cache_delta_us, sampling_factor]
End-to-end tests that inject synthetic KV cache hit/miss patterns and assert reconciliation delta within 3% of ground truth
Dataplane CPU overhead from instrumentation must be <= 0.5% p95 for production traffic with sampling enabled
New dashboard panels showing (a) sampled vs estimated token cost, (b) per-route cache delta heatmap, (c) sampling coverage by model and seq_len
Migration plan + feature flag to enable on 10% of live requests before ramping to 100%
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha Patel: Initial write-up. Added goals and rough acceptance criteria. Called out required reconciliation fields. Linking to ENG-31999 for baseline token timing schema.

Observations: sampling stratified by sequence length reduced traces by 5x; however small sequences (<=8) bias estimator. Plan: add per-stratum correction factor computed from recent windows.

2025-02-25 Priya Shah (observability): Review feedback - prefer "inferred_total_tokens" instead of extrapolating from batch_size to avoid double-counting cache-primed requests. Also requested explicit metric names for export. Added to artifacts.

2025-02-28 Liam Chen: PR submitted for runtime hook (runtime/pull/1284). Added flag --token-sampler-config and default sampling config: {"sample_rate":0.12,"burst_size":20,"stratify_by":"sequence_len"}. CPU microbenchmarks show 0.3% p95 overhead on our benchmark infra.

2025-03-03 Observability oncall (Marco Ruiz): Integrated reconciliation records into the telemetry pipeline (telemetry/pull/409). Found an indexing mismatch with request_id in the log router; fixed by normalizing request_id in exporter. Added smoke dashboard panels.

2025-03-04 QA (Elena Gomez): Ran synthetic KV-cache test harness against canary. Reconciliation error: 4.8% on 1M short-sequence requests. Action: add bias-correction per-stratum using reservoir of recent full-trace samples. Assigned follow-up subtask ENG-47697.
